elements.title: Monthly Consumption of Coal for Electricity Generation in the United States from 2016 to 2022

details.values: Exact values unreadable; plot shows time series data with Value fluctuating monthly, SMA smoothing over 12 months, Diff showing first-order difference

elements.summary: This line chart displays the monthly coal consumption values for electricity generation in the US from 2016 to 2022, along with a 12-month simple moving average and the first-order difference of the values, illustrating trends and changes over time.
